numbering_rule: Warm-Ups are numbered 1-20 within each Unit and are not owned/numbered by section.
student_label_rule: Q3 and Q4 visibly display exact canonical I Can code + full exact I Can statement. Q1/Q2 do not require a forced MG/I Can label.

retrieval_rules.unit_1: Use readiness/foundational retrieval and already-taught Algebra only when useful; do not fake a previous Unit.
retrieval_rules.unit_2: Q3 strongly favors Unit 1 I Cans. Q4 may use a second Unit 1 target or readiness/foundational retrieval; avoid same-current-Unit dependence.
retrieval_rules.unit_3_plus_Q3: Favor the immediately previous Unit. Across 20 slots, distribute all prior-unit I Cans before repeating high-value targets.
retrieval_rules.unit_3_plus_Q4: Favor two Units back. Reserve several late slots for deliberate long-range retrieval from 3+ Units back when available.
retrieval_rules.same_unit: Same-current-Unit retrieval is an exception because Practice/Activities own most within-Unit recurrence.
retrieval_rules.stability: Plan the 20-set sequence before student use; do not change common Warm-Ups after some students/classes have begun using them merely in response to live performance.

deterministic_rotation.Q3_default: For a four-MG previous Unit, cycle MG01, MG02, MG03, MG04 across Warm-Ups and rotate IC01-IC04 before deliberate repeats. Exact family/seed is selected from the approved Bank.
deterministic_rotation.Q4_default: For a four-MG two-units-back source, cover all sixteen I Cans across early/middle Warm-Ups, then use remaining slots for high-value long-range retrieval.
deterministic_rotation.seed_rule: Generated Bank instances should be reproducible from stored seed/parameters when the family supports deterministic generation.
